title: SpaceBan/set has no ban permission check
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 SpaceBan/set: create, update ('Requires "ban" permission in the Space.', new in 1e33ec7) and destroy all require the ban permission. ban.rs:180-375 checks only readonly/allowed keys; permissions.rs has no BAN constant. Any account can create, edit or lift bans. Found by the 1e33ec7 audit (wf_af4656ea-dbb, both refuters upheld). Fix with a failing test quoting the draft; extend chat_client_wire.rs where the client exercises it.
notes: fix done in 029a7bfe: tests/space_ban_permissions.rs (create_requires_ban_permission, update_requires_ban_permission, destroy_requires_ban_permission)
